essence: Sweet speech ravishing thought, seer and seen: the conqueror whose greatness is manifest bliss.

sections.SUMMARY: Honeyed lips ravish thought; seen and seer meet; the bliss-manifest great Lord triumphs — high God.

rasa.dominant: adbhuta with bhakti (wonder at manifest greatness)
rasa.justification: Maṅgala opening: speech ravishing, mutual seeing, triumph proclaimed; wonder at greatness resolving into devotion.
